title: Surviving Defenders After Province Destruction
summary: Alfredo requested the correction to the province-less battle display. Please check the occupied resolved primary remains visible after its extra front destroys the province. Expert acceptance and merge remain pending.
review_steps: Extract the ZIP, then open Start Review.cmd. It opens Resolved defenders after province destruction directly. The resolved primary retains its defending survivor and attachment; the extra front is the active battle.
Inspect the survivor in Open battlefield A, then its attachment. Switch Other seat and repeat. Both players must see the same public survivors.
Use View battlefield A/B in the sidebar. Navigation moves the camera only; B remains the active battle and A is not offered for resolution again.
Resize the window, try the original scenarios in the dropdown, and check standalone courts, destroyed provinces, multiple fronts and attachments remain inspectable.

The prepared scenes disable engine commands and do not simulate card effects. Open Full Game.cmd opens the same source build for ordinary gameplay. Report expected/actual behavior and the scenario using Send Feedback.url.
known_limitations: This correction is on an unmerged review branch. Mendon/Nathan mechanics/presentation acceptance remains pending; no merge is authorized.

Prepared scenarios exercise public-view presentation. A separate passing Core regression executes the actual Two Fronts sequence, checks both seats, verifies the resolved front is not a legal selection, and checks retirement at phase end.
No authoritative rules, resolution, commands or public wire contracts change. Separate PR #570 gameplay choices/payments are not included in this build.
Local graphical input tests ran on macOS. Windows CI verifies the exact package, runtime and launch arguments; it does not establish Windows graphical playability.
